title.narrative: Accelerating investment in efficient and renewable district energy systems in Chile

description.narrative: Accelerate the decarbonisation of the heating sector in Chile by fostering the deployment of district energy systems
Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.
